svg.aria-label: The two data contracts: ingestion (the site catalog) and artifact (the manifests), and the gates that enforce them
svg.text: Two data contracts and the gates that enforce them (bring your own site: edit one file, run the bake, every page follows)
Dos contratos de datos y las compuertas que los aplican (traiga su sitio: edite un archivo, corra la cocina, cada pagina lo sigue)
Contract 1: ingestion (what a site must declare)
Contrato 1: ingesta (lo que un sitio debe declarar)
data/examples/sites.json (schema rajo.site/v1)
id ^[a-z0-9-]+$ name_en name_es country ISO3
categories: copper-chile copper-world lithium iron coal ...
lon lat (seed) window_km 4..40 first_year 1984..2026
season {start_month end_month} facts [{text_en text_es source}]
commodity operator flags transition_year closure_year
The catalog stage refuses
La etapa catalog rechaza
a seed farther than 3 km from a Maus 2022 polygon (unless flagged)
una semilla a mas de 3 km de un poligono Maus 2022 (salvo bandera)
a window outside 4 to 40 km, a first year outside 1984 to 2026
una ventana fuera de 4 a 40 km, un primer ano fuera de 1984 a 2026
a fact without a source URL, a category outside the vocabulary
un hecho sin URL de fuente, una categoria fuera del vocabulario
and writes per site
y escribe por sitio
site.json (the UTM grid, width a multiple of 3 px)
polygons.geojson (CC BY-SA 4.0, from Maus 2022)
Contract 2: artifact (what the web may read)
Contrato 2: artefacto (lo que la web puede leer)
data/derived/catalog.json (schema rajo.catalog/v1)
sites/<id>/manifest.json:
site window polygons engine_version
frames[] {year sensor scene_ids date clear_pct data_pct
image swir_image stretch flags collection masks{}}
gaps {year: reason}
series {years sensor valid_frac area_km2 index_mean
methods{pelt cusum} change_points dense}
dem {epochs delta_png cut fill noise_floor_m geoid terrain_tiles}
files[] {path kind bytes sha256}
Each stage writes a side-car; export assembles; validate refuses
Cada etapa escribe un lateral; export arma; validate rechaza
a missing file, a byte or sha256 drift, a year with neither a frame nor
un archivo faltante, una deriva de bytes o sha256, un ano sin cuadro ni
a reason, a series naming a year without a frame, two engine versions,
razon, una serie con un ano sin cuadro, dos versiones del motor,
a CR byte in a text artifact (LF everywhere, hashed as stored).
un byte CR en un artefacto de texto (LF en todo, hasheado tal cual).
The flow, and where the gates sit
El flujo, y donde estan las compuertas
sites.json
30 sites, 12 in Chile,
30 sitios, 12 en Chile,
hand-declared, sourced facts
declarados a mano, con fuente
gate: contracts.py
compuerta: contracts.py
validate_sites against
validate_sites contra
44,929 reference polygons
44.929 poligonos de referencia
the bake (9 stages)
resumable, parallel per site,
reanudable, paralela por sitio,
sandbox by default
sandbox por defecto
gate: validate +
compuerta: validate +
check_artifacts.py
in CI and before every deploy
en CI y antes de cada despliegue
the web (replay)
copy-data overlay,
superposicion copy-data,
contract.ts mirror
The models carry their own registry
Los modelos llevan su propio registro
models/registry.json: id method file bytes sha256 opset
input output training_data split params scores parity
Each model card in the app reads this file; the browser session opens the same ONNX.
Cada ficha de modelo en la app lee este archivo; el navegador abre el mismo ONNX.
Sandbox versus release
Sandbox versus release
Without --release everything goes to build/; --release writes data/derived and
Sin --release todo va a build/; --release escribe data/derived y se acepta
is accepted for all, export, validate and the derived stages only: one frames
solo para all, export, validate y las etapas derivadas: una sola etapa
stage into the canonical tree is how a partial bake happens. Parallel workers
frames en el arbol canonico es como ocurre una cocina parcial. Los workers
bake into one sandbox; harvest.py moves only complete sites.
paralelos cocinan en un sandbox; harvest.py mueve solo sitios completos.
Licences travel with the data: the per-site polygons stay CC BY-SA 4.0 (Maus 2022 share-alike); the Copernicus, USGS, EOX and OpenFreeMap
Las licencias viajan con los datos: los poligonos por sitio siguen CC BY-SA 4.0 (Maus 2022); las cadenas de Copernicus, USGS, EOX y
strings are rendered verbatim on the Data page and in the map attribution.
OpenFreeMap se muestran textuales en la pagina Datos y en la atribucion del mapa.
